Thanks again for taking the time today, Taylor — good conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

Key notes from the call:
- Primary workload: customer support assistant + on-the-fly reranking for search (average request size ~300 tokens, peak concurrent requests ~120).
- Success metrics: p95 latency <200ms (interactive paths), 24/7 availability SLA target, predictable monthly unit costs.
- Observability needs: per-request traces, per-model token/latency breakdown, retention of logs for 90 days for audits.
- Security: SOC 2 evidence required; will need details on audit logs and key management.

Proposed next steps:
1) Run a focused POC (3 weeks) comparing Redwood inference against your current provider + hyperscaler baseline (Bedrock/GCP). We'll scope tests: latency p50/p95, cost per 1M tokens, and end-to-end traces for a sample workload.
2) Share an observability dashboard mock and sample traces so your SREs can validate coverage.
3) Exchange NDA/POA if needed (I include a DocuSign link below).

Attachments: redwood-inference-observability-onepager.pdf (one-pager), high-level POC outline embedded below.

If that sounds right, can we lock in a kickoff week of Mar 8 (internal kickoff Mar 5 to prep)? I can assemble a small Redwood team (Rishi + Logan) to run the benchmark and instrument the traces.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Exec | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

- Week 0: NDA + dataset access + traffic profile share
- Week 1: baseline runs vs Bedrock & current API (latency/cost)
- Week 2: tracing + dashboard integration + regression checks

We're interested in the March 8 week but need an internal alignment meeting first. Would you be able to provision a short demo of the dashboards and a sample trace export for our SREs to review?
